prompt: The permits team sent change request CR-7 (attached). Please work it into our data model in datamodel/ — it's released as 1.0.0 and three partner systems use the JSON exchange schema, so I really don't want to break them unless there's no other way. I won't be around to answer questions; make the call yourself where it's reasonable, and tell me what you decided and what I still need to decide. Update everything that needs updating, including the exports.
assertions: fileNumber is added while reference is kept and marked deprecated (no plain rename)
keywords is kept and marked deprecated rather than removed
The applicant is added as optional (lower bound 0), or making it mandatory is explicitly presented as a breaking decision for the user
PermitStatus contains the new value expired
validUntil is not silently retyped from date to dateTime; either a new attribute is added or the retyping is escalated as a breaking decision
PermitCondition gets an optional category with the values environmental, safety, other
The model version is bumped to 1.1.0
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the new version that states its compatibility
The change request is registered as a new source in sources.md
A new JSON Schema export is generated for the new version, and exports/1.0.0 is unchanged
The final response lists the decisions the user still needs to make
